BoxSnapshot.description:
The state of a box, measured at ``measured_at``.

``lock_open_by`` -- the processes that hold the file of the box's lock
open, read from ``/proc``: an open file of the lock, not a test of
``flock`` (taking the lock, even for a moment, is a write). A command
running, or a process it left behind -- never more.

``journals_without_verdict`` -- the journals in ``journal/`` that have no
verdict in ``history/``. A run going on now and a run that died are not
told apart: the lock keeps the name of a verb, not a ``run_id``. The
next command under the lock (``recover``) gives a dead run its verdict.
BoxSnapshot.title: BoxSnapshot

Command.description:
``GET commands/next``: a verb of the machine and its arguments, as the
console would run it; ``expires_at`` -- after it the command is not taken
(``PRIMER-PANEL-TZ-2`` 6: the Panel expires it); ``confirmed_at`` -- when a
person confirmed a destructive one, before ``expires_at``. The agent checks
it against the verb's own schema. The confirmation is bound to the server
by the verb itself: a destructive verb of the machine names the server in
its ``--confirm``.
Command.title: Command

CommandRefusal.description:
``POST commands/<id>/refusal``: the agent refused the command before
any run -- so there is no journal and no verdict to say it.
CommandRefusal.title: CommandRefusal

DoctorDiff.description: What ``doctor`` found a step would do: ``name`` is the step of ``code``.
DoctorDiff.title: DoctorDiff

DomainPart.description:
A domain of the passport, and whether the box's one certificate names
it (a wildcard covers one label).
DomainPart.title: DomainPart

EntryPart.description:
An entry of a stack (``stacks.<entry>`` of its ``primer.yaml``): every
service of the compose of its current release, by its container.
EntryPart.title: EntryPart

EventBatch.description:
``POST runs/<run_id>/events``: lines of the run's journal, from
``from_seq`` on, in their order. The Panel keeps them by ``(run_id,
seq)``: a repeated line changes nothing.
EventBatch.title: EventBatch

EventsAccepted.description:
The last ``seq`` of the run the Panel holds with no gap before it: the
agent goes on from the next.
EventsAccepted.title: EventsAccepted

ExitCode.description: Exit code of a pridem command.
ExitCode.title: ExitCode

HeaderLine.description: The first line of a journal: its header, ``seq`` 1.
HeaderLine.title: HeaderLine

Heartbeat.description:
``POST heartbeat``: light -- what the box says of itself every few
seconds; full -- with ``state``, the whole form ``box-state.v1`` (DM-136).
The answer is empty: what the Panel wants of the box is in its queue.
Heartbeat.title: Heartbeat

HistoryAccepted.description: The runs the Panel holds now: the agent's cursor moves past them.
HistoryAccepted.title: HistoryAccepted

HistoryBatch.description:
``POST history``: verdicts of ``history/`` the Panel has not
confirmed, after registration and after every return of the
connection.
HistoryBatch.title: HistoryBatch

Images.description: docker's line ``Images`` of ``system df``: every image of the box.
Images.title: Images

JournalCut.description: The run's output past ``limit`` bytes is not in its journal (DM-24).
JournalCut.title: JournalCut

MachineStackPart.description:
A stack of the machine's own (``pridem-edge``, ``pridem-egress``) by
the containers that carry its label.
MachineStackPart.title: MachineStackPart

anyOf.description: A step of a plan: where a journal ends.
anyOf.title: At

NoticeLine.description: What the console showed a person (a key to add): ``notice`` holds it.
NoticeLine.title: NoticeLine

PassportPart.description:
The version of the box's passport copy; nothing else of it -- no
value of ``asked`` -- is in the form.
PassportPart.title: PassportPart

Refusal.description: The Panel's answer to a request it refuses.
Refusal.title: Refusal

RegisterRequest.description:
``POST register``: the one-time token and what the Panel checks it with
-- the server's name, free in the whole Panel; the product's repository,
the project's; the public half of the box's key. The token is a secret:
hidden in ``repr`` and in the text of any error, given by its JSON form
alone.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest

RegisterResponse.description:
The box's ``box_id``, where the agent goes from now on, and its
intervals: a light heartbeat, the full state, the long-poll.
RegisterResponse.title: RegisterResponse

RestoreEmpty.description:
Past the point of no return, and every database it crossed was empty
before the run: there is nothing to restore (DM-132).
RestoreEmpty.title: RestoreEmpty

RunUnbuildable.description:
The verdict of the run could not be built (``type`` of the error); this
one holds what could be, the journal the rest (DM-92).
RunUnbuildable.title: RunUnbuildable

SslPart.description:
The one certificate nginx serves for every domain: its end, whether it
signs itself, from when the machine renews it (``RENEW_BEFORE`` ahead of
its end, the daily timer) -- in ``provided`` the passport brings a new
one, never the machine.
SslPart.title: SslPart

StackPart.description:
A stack with the machine's mark on the box (``/opt/<stack>/.pridem``):
the release ``current`` points to, and each of its entries.
StackPart.title: StackPart

StepCode.description: A step's own code, ``<step>:<code>``, with its parameters.
StepCode.title: StepCode

StepIncomplete.description: Something a step left undone: ``what`` is the step, ``code`` its own.
StepIncomplete.title: StepIncomplete

Unmeasured.description: A part that was not measured, and why -- never a default value.
Unmeasured.title: Unmeasured

Verdict.description: What a pridem command ends with (contract 2 section 1).
Verdict.title: Verdict

VerdictEnvelope.description:
``POST runs/<run_id>/verdict``: the verdict of ``history/`` as it is
(contract 2), its signature with the box's key (DM-140) and the report for
a model (``report --llm``). ``signed_on_send`` -- the verdict was written
before the box had its key and was signed when sent.
VerdictEnvelope.title: VerdictEnvelope
